items.title: Clyde Kerr Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: Yeah I played on that with Pat LaBelle. I did two albums with her.

ctx.x: I was poking around on the internet and for some reason I saw this thing about Lady Marmalade. You played on that?
Yeah I played on that with Pat LaBelle. I did two albums with her. Yeah. That was the one I was thinking about, yeah.
You just show up and the music’s there and you’ve got to nail it, right?
